objective: Repair attached literal hash suffix corruption in MarkdownFile heading titles only. Current source "# C#" becomes title "C" and both heading/section lookup by "C#" fail. Within already recognized ATX lines, only a terminal run of hashes separated from preceding title by a space or tab is a closing marker. Attached hashes remain literal title text, including when followed by trailing whitespace or by a separate closing run. Preserve current trimming and separated closer behavior, empty titles, levels, source line numbers, fence exclusion, hierarchy boundaries, lookup semantics and exact original content. Markdown remains a narrow raw-text helper: no inline escape decoding or full CommonMark parser, no new indentation/opening grammar, no source-fidelity redesign. Only the existing authorized model file may change. Acquire complete current owner via read_source before editing; tests and sibling models are authorized reads. Public behavioral acceptance is frozen and separate final acceptance is withheld. No reference repair provided. Propose an exact grounded edit and use managed checks; repair within the finite bounds if validation identifies an issue.
oracle:
from pathlib import Path
from devtools.core.paths import ResolvedPath

cases = [
    ('### F##  ', 'F##'),
    ('## alpha#beta###', 'alpha#beta###'),
    ('# end#\t', 'end#'),
    ('# C## ###', 'C##'),
    ('# word ### tail#', 'word ### tail#'),
    ('# word\t####\t ', 'word'),
    ('# ##', ''),
    ('# ', ''),
    ('# x \\#', 'x \\#'),
    ('# foo #\\##', 'foo #\\##'),
    ('###### Plain', 'Plain'),
]
for source, expected in cases:
    document = module.MarkdownFile(ResolvedPath(Path.cwd() / 'holdout.md'), source + '\n')
    assert len(document.headings) == 1, repr(source)
    heading = document.headings[0]
    assert heading.text == expected, (source, expected, heading.text)
    assert document.find_heading(expected, case_sensitive=True) == heading
    assert document.find_section(expected).title == expected
    assert document.content == source + '\n'

source = '# Root#\r\nBody\r\n## Child## ###\r\nData\r\n```text\r\n# hidden#\r\n```\r\n# NEXT#\r\nDone\r\n'
document = module.MarkdownFile(ResolvedPath(Path.cwd() / 'hierarchy.md'), source)
assert [(h.level,h.text,h.line) for h in document.headings] == [(1,'Root#',1),(2,'Child##',3),(1,'NEXT#',8)]
assert [(s.title,s.start_line,s.end_line) for s in document.sections] == [('Root#',1,7),('Child##',3,7),('NEXT#',8,9)]
assert document.find_section('next#').content == 'Done'
assert document.find_heading('hidden#') is None
assert document.content == source
